title: How To Add Your Social Media Profile Links To Your Brilliant Directories Website | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Settings » General Settings » Social Media Tab Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558389 This article reviews links for the Social Media accounts for the website, members and visitors will be able to access the full spectrum of profiles available for the website and it helps link the social media world to the website Social Media Accounts Below is a full list of the Social Media accounts linked to the website. Important note: The system will ask for absolute URLs. For example: facebook.com will not be accepted https://www.facebook.com will be accepted Visual Guide of the Social Media Links tab 1. Facebook Add a link to the website's facebook account using the following format: https://www.facebook.com/CompanyFacebook 2. Twitter Add a link to the website's Twitter account using the following format: https://www.twitter.com/CompanyTwitter 3. LinkedIn Add a link to the website's LinkedIn account using the following format: https://www.linkedin.com/CompanyLinkedIn 4. Pinterest Add a link to the website's Pinterest account using the following format: https://www.pinterest.com/CompanyPinteres 5. Instagram Add a link to the website's Instagram account using the following format: https://www.instagram.com/CompanyInstagram 6. Youtube Add a link to the website's Youtube account using the following format: https://www.youtube.com/CompanyYouTube 7. RSS Feed Add a link to the website's RSS feed using the following format: https://www.yourwebsite.com/rss 8. Tik Tok Add a link to the website's TikTok account using the following format: https://www.tiktok.com/@name 9. Whatsapp Add a link to the website's WhatsApp account using the following format: https://wa.me/1XXXXXXXXXX 10. Snapchat Add a link to the website's Snapchat accout using the following format: https://www.snapchat.com/add/username Where Do These Links Appear? Inside the Footer Menu of the website: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
